t: The Magic Rolling Pin: A Human-AI Approach to Code Refactoring
s: This article introduces the 'Magic Rolling Pin' concept, an AI-driven method for systematically refactoring codebases to a 'rule of 7' idiomatic ideal. It emphasizes a human-AI collaborative approach, CLI-based AI assistants, and the use of Nix for environment portability.
sub: AI-assisted code refactoring using the 'Magic Rolling Pin' paradigm
Transitioning from IDEs (VSCode) to CLI-based AI interaction (Gemini CLI)
Achieving codebase simplicity via a 'rule of 7' (5-9 items per directory) structure
Environment portability and stability using NixOS and Flakes
Human-AI collaboration in software development workflows
